mcqs.question: According to The Lancet Public Health, what was the number of second-hand smoke deaths in India in 2023?
mcqs.explanation: India recorded 3,25,600 second-hand smoke deaths in 2023, up from 2,17,700 in 1990. The tempting figure 2,17,700 refers to 1990, while 444 million is the exposed population in India and 767 million is the number of exposed children worldwide.
